fact: The Ministry of Health's Annual Vital Statistics Report 2024, dated March 2025, states that the National Civil Registration Office (Department of Civil Status) is the primary source and legal authority for vital statistics data in Seychelles, and that its 1,333 registered live births and 850 registered deaths for 2024 were cross-verified against hospital records; it does not say how the Civil Status record is made.
title: Annual Vital Statistics Report 2024
